column7: The evidence webhook endpoint (which can carry a token in userinfo, path or query) reached the insecure_skip_verify startup warning, the NewWebhook validation errors (invalid URL via the wrapped url.Parse *url.Error, plaintext http, unsupported scheme, private target) and, through the http.Client *url.Error, the delivery error returned by ForwardEvidence. Confirmed red before the fix (TestWebhook_InsecureSkipVerifyWarningRedactsEndpoint, TestWebhook_ConstructionErrorsRedactEndpoint, TestWebhook_DeliveryErrorsRedactEndpoint all fail on origin/main). Fixed by naming the destination as scheme+host only (netutil.RedactURLHost) and stripping the *url.Error layer (netutil.RedactErrorURLs).
